data_identity: No task/weather/CI data. All loads, weather and constant CI are artificial diagnostic inputs, not historical observations.
range_basis: All OAT endpoints are PREDECLARED EXPLORATORY ASSUMPTIONS, not manufacturer confidence intervals or calibrated admissible ranges. Positive endpoint ordering and declared operating bounds are retained. The CPU 240 W endpoint tests uncertainty around a TDP reference, not a claimed sustained measurement. GPU full endpoint is not raised beyond the 250 W board reference. UA=0 is a structural ablation. No range may change after execution.
plant_policy: For power.* OAT only, retain baseline coil rating, air conductance, airflow and supply fan kW: same physical plant, no implicit HVAC resizing. Thermal parameter OAT recomputes only its deterministic downstream design quantities using unchanged IT endpoints. No V1 file is changed.
failure_policy: Preserve unsafe unfiltered trajectories and every safe-filter infeasibility as results, never tune parameters or rerun. Log partial completion rather than invent full-window values. Exceptions other than declared no-safe-action are engineering errors; keep the consumed once marker and report incomplete work. Unit fixture tests are not this batch.
